There are many playable characters: Axel, Adam, Blaze, Skate (aka Sammy), Max, Dr. Zan, Roo (aka Victy) and Shiva, and two guest characters: Dee Jay from the Street Fighter series and Kevin Ryan from Garou: Mark of the Wolves (here called Allan). Mr. X and the Syndicate are back (again!), and it's up to our heroes to put an end to their latest project. With 10 levels and five different story modes (Director's Cut A, B, C, D and E), Streets of Rage XXX will give you and your friends a fighting experience you'll want to come back to again and again!

meta.name: Marvel - Infinity War
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 459.82 MB

Adam Warlock warns the earth of the Infinity Stones being sought by Magus, and so earth's heroes divide into teams to collect each Gem. These gems are placed into the possession of The Enchantress, MODOK, Selene, Ronan the Accuser, and Russia's superheroes.
In the end, the gathering of the heroes is what allows Magus to collect them all and try to wipe the floor with them.
Marvel Infinity War is a module created by ZVitor, based on the Marvel Comics Universe, and is a sequel to the Marvel First Alliance series. The game has 74 (soon to be 80+) playable characters plus one secret character. There are also over 36 bosses to contend with. The game uses a six-button control scheme. Each character has at least one special move and an ultra move. There are also many special assist characters to summon.

In olden times, the majestic gods which governed the earth did use the battle axe called "Golden Axe" to banish evil giants.
At length, a new generation was come.
Humans appeared above the earth and were inherited that battle axe.
The departed gods left a final message: "The Axe must bring justice and peace and not be used to unleash dark-rooted evil and destruction..."
But one day, a mysterious death lord suddenly appeared.
Allied with an evil entity, he stole the Golden Axe.
With his entire demon army, he overran the kingdom of Splash Hill, in mid-Eastland, imprisoned and enslaved the people.
It was soon quite clear to Gilius Thunderaxe, a member of the long living Dwarf race, that the axe must be retrieved by any means necessary.
Gilius sought brave warriors to save the people from this crisis. Before long, there were 6 heroes standing before him.

Esta es una nueva entrega de un famoso crossover con la participación de personajes de las series de juegos Battletoads y Double Dragon. Hay 9 misiones diferentes en este juego, cada una de ellas dividida en varias partes.

Sonic Adventure: Revolution is a beat'em up game with characters not just from the games, but other canons too, like the Freedom Fighters, and Sonic's siblings from Underground.
Once you choose a character, you're taken to a map where you can choose any stage and getting to fighting robots. There's 3D gameplay where you move in all directions, 2D where you only move left to right and can jump up platforms and back down by holding down and pressing attack, also hitting enemies under you. There are also mach speed sections, derived from Sonic 06 where you fight while contentiously running at high speed, and the new flight sections exclusive to Campaign 2, same as mach speed, but on extreme gear.
